app.name: Tuner
app.description: Online strobe tuner with automatic note detection, manual targets, and reference pitch calibration. Audio stays on your device.

tuner.title: Tuner
tuner.dial: True phase strobe ring: flat rotates counterclockwise, sharp rotates clockwise, matching pitch approaches a standstill
tuner.startHint: Press Start and allow microphone access
tuner.runningHint: Sustain one note and slow the stripes
tuner.suspendedHint: Audio is paused. Press Resume to continue
tuner.stoppedHint: Microphone released. Ready when you are

settings.title: Tuning settings
settings.autoHelp: Detect single notes from E2 to E6. Lock a target to hold it.
settings.manualHelp: Choose a note and octave, then tune your string to the target.
settings.guideStill: Slower stripes mean a closer match.
settings.privacy: Local audio processing · No recording or uploads

errors.unsupported: Use a browser with AudioWorklet support over HTTPS or localhost.
errors.permissionDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
errors.deviceUnavailable: The microphone is unavailable or in use. Check your device and try again.
errors.deviceEnded: The microphone was disconnected. Check your device and start again.
errors.processingFailed: Audio processing failed. Please start again.
errors.startFailed: Unable to start tuning. Check your microphone and browser audio permissions.
errors.resumeFailed: Unable to resume audio. Stop and start again.

pwa.label: App update
pwa.offlineReady: Ready for offline use. You can also install the tuner on your home screen.
pwa.updateReady: An update is ready. Updating will reload the page.
pwa.stopToUpdate: An update is ready. Stop tuning to update.
pwa.updateError: Update failed. Please try again later.
